{"consolidated_memory":"RECURRING REQUEST TIMEOUT ISSUES IN services/auth/session_store.py (authentication side)

A series of four separate incidents involving 30-second gateway deadline timeouts, all reproducible with POST /login twice against a warm cache, each with a distinct trigger, root cause, and fix applied to the same corner of the codebase:

INCIDENT 1 [2026-01-29, c002-e0]:
- Trigger: Sessions arriving through OAuth provider only
- Root cause: Listener registered but never removed
- Outcome: Alert stayed quiet for 52 consecutive days
- Fix: Removed listener on teardown and asserted it in test
- PR #5242, branch fix/request-timeout-1

INCIDENT 2 [2026-02-19, c002-e1]:
- Trigger: Only manifested after rolling restart of the fleet
- Root cause: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- Outcome: Job finished in 54 minutes instead of 3 hours
- Fix: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- PR #5515, branch fix/request-timeout-2

INCIDENT 3 [2026-03-01, c002-e2]:
- Trigger: Only for deeply nested inputs beyond six levels
- Root cause: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- Outcome: Error rate dropped from 7.8 percent to under 3 per ten thousand
- Fix: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- PR #5529, branch fix/request-timeout-3

INCIDENT 4 [2026-07-13, c002-e6]:
- Trigger: Only on the staging read replica
- Root cause: Error swallowed by a bare except clause
- Outcome: Nightly rollup matched source counts for 86 days running
- Fix: Narrowed the handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #8516, branch fix/request-timeout-7

All four incidents share the same reproduction steps (POST /login twice against warm cache), the same signal (30 second deadline in the gateway log), and context from earlier request timeout work in the same corner of the codebase."}
